name: Fractured Divergence
source:
Cassian, and his friends, Franz and Maike, spend their lives as usual. But a visit to a mysterious place changes everything for all of them.

[From [url=https://thejayduck.itch.io/fractured-divergence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡西安和朋友弗朗茨、迈克过着一如往常的日子。直到三人去了一个神秘的地方，他们的生活从此变了样。

［摘自[url=https://thejayduck.itch.io/fractured-divergence]itch.io[/url]］
